dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.jface.text.table.setsize.to.setbounds>
<!description: Replace table.setSize with table.setBounds(0,0,...) to ensure explicit location setting to (0,0) for SWT Table widgets.>
<!severity: WARNING>

$table.setSize($width, $height) :: instanceof($table, "org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Table")
=> $table.setBounds(0, 0, $width, $height)
;;
summary: Replace setSize with setBounds(0,0,...) for SWT Table widgets to ensure explicit location setting.
